_doc: Global combat tuning. Rules: docs/gdd/01-combat.md. Initial guesses, tune via bot fights. HP scale assumption: Creatures 100-200 HP, ability base damage 10-40. Collision damage is fixed, so price push distance in ability data. collapse_at and bloom_at are per Arena (arena data); recharge_steps is per fighter (creature/monster data). Durations and delays are in steps.
